principle_violations.reason: The Order class manages order items, quantities, prices, and the order status, which violates the Single Responsibility Principle. The PaymentProcessor class directly modifies the Order's status, coupling payment logic with order status management.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate order status management and payment processing into distinct classes. Consider creating an OrderManager class for managing the order and its status. For the PaymentProcessor, separate verification and payment execution.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violation found. Please see the details below.
